mapper.select: select g.id, g.goods_code, g.goods_name, g.price, g.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, g.intro, g.remark, g.create_time from goods g left join supplier s on g.supplier_id = s.id where g.goods_code = #{goodsCode} limit 1
select g.id, g.goods_code, g.goods_name, g.price, g.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, g.intro, g.remark, g.create_time from goods g left join supplier s on g.supplier_id = s.id
mapper.insert: insert into goods(goods_code, goods_name, price, supplier_id, intro, remark) values(#{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{price}, #{supplierId}, #{intro}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update goods set goods_code = #{goodsCode}, goods_name = #{goodsName}, price = #{price}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, intro = #{intro}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
